name: Mitten Extracts Max Pro Disposable | OG Kush
description:
This classic indica strain features earthy pine and sour lemon flavors, known for its relaxing and calming body high. It’s perfect for winding down after a long day, providing soothing relaxation and stress relief.

Packed with 3G of Liquid Diamonds + Live Resin terpenes for a smooth, powerful experience that lasts. Fine-tune every hit with Flavor, Balance, or Clouds mode.
